# Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(randomForest)
library(ranger)
library(caret)
library(performance)
```

# Load data
```{r}
source("_config.r")

# Load plant model data
plant_data <- readRDS(PATH_MDL3_PLANT_DATA)
plant_richness <- readRDS(PATH_PLANT_RICHNESS)
```

# Data preparation
## Remove target column and plot ID
```{r}
# Remove year and ID columns
plant_data <- plant_data |>
  dplyr::select(-yearPl, -aID_STAO)

dim(plant_data) # 1442 x 21
```

## CV model using best hyperparameters
The best hyperparameters are essentially the default ones, thus the CV model is run again with the standard parameters to get a more stable estimate of performance across all folds and repeats.
```{r}
# Set best hyperparameters
best_mtry <- floor(sqrt(ncol(plant_data)))
best_min_node_size <- 3

train_control <- caret::trainControl(
  method          = "repeatedcv",
  number          = 5,
  repeats         = 10,
  savePredictions = "all",
  returnResamp    = "all"
)

# Fit CV model with best hyperparameters to get performance metrics across all folds/repeats
set.seed(123)
rf_plant_cv_std <- caret::train(
  richness_plant ~ .,
  data        = plant_data,
  method      = "ranger",
  num.trees   = 500,
  trControl   = train_control,
  tuneGrid    = expand.grid(
    mtry          = best_mtry,
    splitrule     = "variance",
    min.node.size = best_min_node_size
  ),
  na.action   = na.omit,
  num.threads = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  verbose     = TRUE
)

rf_plant_cv_std

# Manual summary across all folds/repeats with standard parameters
resamp_std <- rf_plant_cv_std$resample
data.frame(
  metric = c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE"),
  mean   = colMeans(resamp_std[, c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE")], na.rm = TRUE),
  sd     = apply(resamp_std[, c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE")], 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
)
#           metric       mean         sd
# RMSE         RMSE 12.0593867 0.37903048
# Rsquared Rsquared  0.3772731 0.03807211
# MAE           MAE  9.6728532 0.31332123

# Save the CV model and results
saveRDS(rf_plant_cv_std, file = file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "plant_richness/rf_plant_std_cv.rds"))
write.csv(rf_plant_cv_std$results, file = file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "plant_richness/rf_plant_std_cv_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Fit final model using all data
```{r}
# Fit final model using all data with best hyperparameters
rf_plant_final <- ranger::ranger(
  formula     = richness_plant ~ .,
  data        = plant_data,
  num.trees   = 500,
  mtry        = best_mtry,
  min.node.size = best_min_node_size,
  importance   = "permutation",
  num.threads = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  write.forest = TRUE,
  keep.inbag  = TRUE,
  oob.error   = TRUE,
  verbose     = TRUE,
  seed        = 123
)

rf_plant_final
# OOB prediction error (MSE):       146.8082 
# R squared (OOB):                  0.3636318 

# Save final model
saveRDS(rf_plant_final, file = file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "plant_richness/rf_plant_final_model.rds"))
```

## Variable importance
```{r}
# Extract variable importance p-values via Altmann permutation test
set.seed(123)
imp_pvals <- ranger::importance_pvalues(
  rf_plant_final,
  method            = "altmann",
  formula           = richness_plant ~ .,
  data              = plant_data,
  num.permutations  = 100,
  num.threads       = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  verbose           = TRUE,
)

var_importance <- as.data.frame(imp_pvals) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") |>
  dplyr::arrange(pvalue)

var_importance

# Save variable importance
write.csv(var_importance, file = file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "plant_richness/rf_plant_variable_importance.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
